annotations.title: Match a resume to a job

description: Compare a resume with a job posting: the posting's keywords found in the resume (with how they matched: exact, normalized, alias or stem, and the matched span), the ones missing with the posting sentence they come from, each term's weight and whether the posting lists it as required or preferred, and weighted overall, required and preferred coverage. Posting 120–20,000 characters. Rules version 2026-10-19.2.

job_description.description: The full job posting as plain text, including its requirements (120–20,000 characters). For a link, call fetch_job_post first.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

name: match_job
